title: Goldman Sachs style · Quant, CS + Coding
description: Quant and CS MCQs with two coding problems. 20 MCQs + 2 coding problems in 120 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text: The price of an item is first increased by 25% and then decreased by 10%. What is the net percentage change in its price?
questions.explanation: Net factor = (1 + 25/100)(1 - 10/100) = 9/8, so the change is 25/2%: a 25/2% increase.

questions.text: What is 45% of 840?
The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 4:3. After 4 years, the ratio will be 9:7. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 4x and 3x. (4x+4)/(3x+4) = 9/7 gives x = 8; A = 32.

questions.text: If today is Saturday, what day of the week will it be after 238 days?
questions.explanation: 238 mod 7 = 0; Saturday + 0 days = Saturday.

questions.text: What are the roots of x² + 9x + 20 = 0?
questions.explanation: Sum of roots = -9, product = 20: the roots are -5 and -4.

questions.text: In what ratio must rice at Rs 20/kg be mixed with rice at Rs 50/kg so that the mixture costs Rs 42/kg?
questions.explanation: Alligation: (cheaper : dearer) = (50 − 42) : (42 − 20) = 4:11.

questions.text: A man is facing West. He turns left, then turns right, then turns about, then turns right. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Right = 90° clockwise, left = 90° anticlockwise, about = 180°. Final direction: South.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 13, 57, 17, 67?
questions.explanation: 57 — all others are prime.

questions.text: Kavya is the father of Chitra. Chitra is the sister of Lokesh. How is Kavya related to Lokesh?
questions.explanation: Lokesh is Chitra's sibling, so Kavya is Lokesh's father too.

questions.text:
What is the output? (div = integer division)

n = 6202
r = 0
while n > 0
    r = r * 10 + (n mod 10)
    n = n div 10
end while
print r
questions.explanation: Trace the loop digit by digit.

questions.text:
What is the output of this pseudocode?

s = 0
for i = 1 to 12 step 2
    s = s + i * i
end for
print s
questions.explanation: The loop takes i = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11; the result is 286.

questions.text: Starting with an empty stack, these operations run: push(25), pop(), push(44), push(14), pop(), pop(), push(40), pop(), push(27). What is at the top now?
questions.explanation: Simulating the operations, the top element is 27.

questions.text: Starting with an empty queue (push = enqueue, pop = dequeue), these operations run: push(5), push(8), push(40), push(7), pop(), push(39). What is at the front now?
questions.explanation: Simulating the operations, the front element is 8.

questions.title: Longest substring without repeats
questions.text:
Print the length of the longest substring of s that has no repeated characters.

Input: one string of 1 to 10^5 lowercase letters.

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
